POSITIVE_FINDINGS: The proposed STOP CAS correctly closes all authority gates and rotates ENGINEERING_EPOCH and MEMBERSHIP_EPOCH, making pre-stop leases/memberships stale for canonical authority.
The repair correctly preserves ACTIVE_INTEGRATION and actual Git truth instead of erasing ambiguous external state.
The repair correctly distinguishes canonical authority from physical Git artifacts and forbids stale artifacts from later integration.

BLOCKING_GAP.TITLE: Absolute stale-membership mutation invariant is not enforced at the physical mutation boundary.
BLOCKING_GAP.OBSERVATION: The repair explicitly permits a durable worker-branch write to physically appear after STOP from stale local state, classifying it as a noncanonical stale artifact. But [241] states 'NEVER LET STALE MEMBERSHIP MUTATE.' Once the STOP CAS increments MEMBERSHIP_EPOCH/ENGINEERING_EPOCH, the actor is stale. A post-CAS worker-branch Git write is therefore still a mutation performed by stale membership, even if later denied canonical authority.
COUNTEREXAMPLE: Worker W passes the repair's local mutation-admission reread while the mission is ACTIVE and epochs match.
USER_STOP linearizes immediately afterward, closes gates, and increments ENGINEERING_EPOCH and MEMBERSHIP_EPOCH.
Before W performs the Git mutation, there is no mandatory atomic sink-side fence check coupled to that Git write.
W creates/updates the isolated worker branch after STOP using now-stale membership.
The repair labels this artifact noncanonical, but the physical mutation already occurred by stale membership, violating [241] and the immediate/preemptive intent of [164].
BLOCKING_GAP.WHY_LOCAL_REREAD_IS_INSUFFICIENT: A non-atomic reread before mutation has the same TOCTOU window as the original defect. It reduces probability but does not prove the absolute invariant.
BLOCKING_GAP.IMPACT: The repair is sufficient for canonical-authority invalidation but insufficient to prove the Constitution's stronger absolute prohibition that stale membership never mutates.

REQUIRED_RESOLUTION_OPTIONS: Enforce a mutation-sink fence token/generation atomically at every worker-branch ref mutation, so Git ref update succeeds only if STOP/fence generation and membership authority still match.

Route all product writes through an authorized mutation gateway that performs compare-and-swap over the current mission/stop generation immediately with the external ref update, or otherwise guarantees equivalent linearizability.

If such sink-level atomicity is impossible, a successor-law activation must explicitly redefine [241]/USER_STOP semantics; a control-layer interpretation must not silently weaken an absolute 'NEVER' invariant.
NOTE: This review does not reject the authority-cut design. It rejects treating that design alone as sufficient to resolve the full current-law mutation-safety invariant.
